exampleEn: I didn't want to bring up the topic of money at dinner.
exampleKo: 저는 저녁에 돈 얘기를 언급하고 싶지 않았어요.
gameExamples: During the meeting, she decided to bring up her concerns about the project timeline.
It's important to bring up any issues you have with the new policy.
I was nervous to bring up the subject of moving to a new city.
